```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Cementon'
    AND border_type = 'city'
    AND ST_GeometryType(geometry) = 'ST_Polygon'
  LIMIT 1
),
raster_clip AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom))
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(raster_clip.rast, 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast
),
flattest_value AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(ST_Value(slope_rast, 1)) AS flattest_slope
  FROM
    slope_raster
)
SELECT
  flattest_slope AS flattest_slope_degrees
FROM
  flattest_value;
```
